editorRuntime.correctionToSourceOnlyHypothesis: Runtime confirms the old main CodeMirror surface was already dark (#171717), because square-theme.css globally supplied --crepe-color-surface. No old white code surface claim is valid. The measured defect was dark placeholder and slash-menu foreground colors.

firstLineToolbarEdgeProbe.notice: The floating toolbar crosses the existing editor scroll edge on the first line in both token states. The color repair does not change this geometry. A second paragraph is used below to exercise a toolbar fully inside the scroll region.

cases.interactionNotice: Original first-line pointer failure is retained in targetedRetries and firstLineToolbarEdgeProbe. Both CSS token states have the same clipped toolbar and failed center hit. Keyboard formatting works in both states; the second-paragraph native pointer formatting also works. No editor implementation or geometry was changed.
